name: Rethinking_Benchmarking_model_editing
description: A benchmark suite for evaluating model-editing methods: how well edits to a model (e.g., changing a fact or fixing a behavior) are applied, generalize to related inputs, and are contained without unintended side effects. It measures correctness of edits, edit generalization, and preservation of unrelated knowledge.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate / exact_match (measuring whether edits produce the intended outputs and avoid regressions)
reputation: A recent research benchmark for the model-editing community; referenced in follow-up work but not yet a widely adopted standard.
